q: The scalar product of vectors $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ is defined as $\mathbf{A} \cdot \mathbf{B} = AB \cos \theta$, where $\theta$ is the angle between $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$. This product is also called the _____
e: A · B = AB cos θ. That number is the dot product, also called the scalar product. The scalar product of vectors A and B is defined as A · B = AB cos θ, where θ is the angle between A and B. This product is also called the dot product. Cross product or vector product is not this quantity.

q: The vector product of vectors $\mathbf{A}$ and $\mathbf{B}$ is denoted by $\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}$. This product is also called the _____
e: A × B is the cross product, a vector perpendicular to both A and B. The vector product of vectors A and B is denoted by A × B. This product is also called the cross product. Do not trade cross product for scalar product or dot product.

q: The scalar product has the commutative property described by the equation _____
e: Dot products make scalars with cos θ. Cross products make perpendicular vectors with sin θ. The scalar product has the commutative property described by the equation A · B = B · A. A × B = B × A or A · B = -B · A is a different relation from A · B = B · A.

q: The vector product does not obey the commutative property, and instead follows the relation _____
e: The cross product anticommutes: A × B = −(B × A). Swap the order and the vector flips. The vector product does not obey the commutative property, and instead follows the relation A × B = - (B × A). A × B = B × A or A · B = - (B · A) is a different relation from A × B = - (B × A).

q: Work is a scalar quantity because it is the _____ of force and displacement.
e: Work is F · s, a dot product, so work is a scalar. Work is a scalar quantity because it is the scalar product of force and displacement. Do not trade scalar product for vector product or cross product.

q: The direction of the vector product $\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}$ is determined by using the _____
e: Dot products make scalars with cos θ. Cross products make perpendicular vectors with sin θ. The direction of the vector product A × B is determined by using the right-hand rule. Do not trade right-hand rule for left-hand rule or Fleming’s rule.

q: The result of the scalar product of two vectors is a _____
e: A dot product is a scalar. The result of the scalar product of two vectors is a scalar. Vector or tensor is not this quantity.

q: The result of the vector product of two vectors is a _____
e: A cross product is a vector. The result of the vector product of two vectors is a vector. Do not trade vector for scalar or unitless number.

q: In circular motion, tangential velocity is expressed in terms of radius $\mathbf{r}$ and angular velocity $\boldsymbol{\omega}$ as _____
e: In circular motion the object stays on a circle. The velocity is tangent and the centripetal acceleration points to the centre. In circular motion, tangential velocity is expressed in terms of radius r and angular velocity boldsymbol{ω} as v = boldsymbol{ω} × r. v = boldsymbol{ω} · r or v = r · boldsymbol{ω} is a different relation from v = boldsymbol{ω} × r.

q: The magnitude of the vector product $\mathbf{A} \times \mathbf{B}$ is given by _____
e: The size of A × B is AB sin θ. The magnitude of the vector product A × B is given by AB sin θ. AB cos θ or AB tan θ is a different relation from AB sin θ.
